representation_fit.evidence: Spatial canvas of draggable canvas_objects across three semantic zones (待选池 Pool / 就位区 Staged / 定稿区 Locked) where physical placement sets state — a direct match to the brief's spatial-workspace shape, canvas_object primary object, and 落位即意图 success criterion (source/core.js:8-12 zone defs, index.html:15 tagline; both screenshots show 3 zones with 9 placed objects at 78%/88% fit zoom).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the canvas: 9 seeded objects already placed in 3 zones (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png); the create affordance is first in the toolbar (＋ 新建 N, index.html:18) and creation is hinted in the persistent status bar '双击空白新建 · 拖拽移动' (index.html:52).

time_to_understand.evidence: Tagline states the interaction model outright ('放进哪个区，就是什么状态 —— 所有空间操作都有键盘等价物', index.html:15); each zone header carries name + live count + hint (source/core.js:92-93; visible in both screenshots); status bar reports zoom/snap/selection/pointer-zone, e.g. '指针不在任何区' (1440x900.png bottom bar).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single-screen structure: all 3 zones and all 9 objects are visible and manipulable at once, no tabs/modes/drill-downs; fitAll() centers the whole workspace on load (source/core.js:156-164, seed at source/core.js:26-42 means the primary object is present at t=0).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: drag-to-rezone with live hot-zone highlight and pointer capture (source/input.js:76-90, 108-122), Ctrl+1/2/3 re-zones without leaving the canvas (source/core.js:212-225), full undo/redo history (source/core.js:60-78); the only modal is the dismissible help overlay (source/input.js:143).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: 13 permanent toolbar buttons plus status bar for a canvas app, each button labeled with its keyboard equivalent via kbd tags (index.html:17-33) — information-dense but near the ceiling: at 1280 the tools row already wraps to a second line (1280x860.png), while the help table stays hidden by default (index.html:55, hidden attribute).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=pass, a11y.target_size=pass, a11y.focus_order=skipped (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows canvas objects are plain divs with no tabindex/ARIA (source/core.js:98-109), Tab is repurposed for object cycling (source/input.js:184-193), and every button is blurred after click (source/input.js:227) — DOM focus traversal is deliberately subordinated to global shortcuts; positives: role=status toast (index.html:51), lang=zh-CN, color coding always paired with text labels (source/core.js:106).

frontend_rework.evidence: Two receipt failures imply rework: layout.overflow=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks; 2 of 7 fail, 1 skipped). Visible defect: toolbar wraps to a second row at 1280 ('快捷键 ?' drops below, 1280x860.png; .tools has flex-wrap:wrap, styles.css:33); at auto-fit 78% zoom the 11-11.5px kbd/zone-hint/meta text projects below minimum size (styles.css:43-44,79,105). No functional errors observed in either viewport; degradation is graceful, not clipped.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 'spatial operations have keyboard equivalents' is covered exhaustively and verifiably: the in-app help table maps every spatial op (create/select/move/pan/zoom/re-zone/reorder/duplicate/delete/edit/undo) to keys (index.html:61-77) and input.js:139-207 implements N, Tab cycle, Ctrl+A, arrow-key grid nudge, Ctrl+1/2/3 zone move, [/] z-order, +/-/0/1 zoom, S snap, Ctrl+Z/Y/D — matching the brief's discriminator clause verbatim.

defects_observed: layout.overflow check fails and is visible: toolbar wraps to a second line at 1280x860, demoting the 快捷键 button (1280x860.png; styles.css:33)
type.min_projected_size check fails: auto-fit zoom of 78% drops ~11px kbd/zone-hint/meta labels below minimum projected size (measurement-summary.json; styles.css:43-44,79)

a11y.focus_order check skipped; source shows no tabindex/ARIA on canvas objects, Tab hijacked for object cycling, and buttons force-blurred after click (source/input.js:184-193,227; source/core.js:98-109)

Ctrl+1/2/3 zone move snaps objects to fixed canonical slots, discarding any user-chosen position within the target zone (source/core.js:219-220) — defensible design, but it overwrites spatial arrangement the brief treats as intent
missing_evidence: a11y.focus_order was skipped in the receipt and no DOM focus/ARIA structure exists in source to verify screen-reader or keyboard traversal of canvas objects
no evidence available for task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, human_preference (per rubric, not observable in blind pilot)
scores.overall_note: The package presents a single-screen spatial canvas whose representation matches the brief almost clause-for-clause: three physical zones define state by placement, nine seeded objects are ready at first paint with no loading state, and the acceptance seed — every spatial operation having a keyboard equivalent — is implemented in code and documented in an in-app help table (index.html:61-77; input.js:139-207). Navigation cost and context loss are both minimal because all actions occur in place on one canvas with undo history. The weaknesses are at the margins: the receipt records 2 failures (layout.overflow, type.min_projected_size) that are visible as a two-line toolbar wrap at 1280x860 and sub-minimum projected text at auto-fit zoom, and the focus-order check was skipped while the source deliberately subverts DOM focus (Tab repurposed, buttons blurred), leaving screen-reader accessibility unverified. This score reflects the visible artifact and receipt only; it is a model-judged blind assessment, not a human preference measurement.
